map.组件制造能耗约 400 kWh/kWp、系统年发电 1300 kWh/kWp：E: Module manufacturing energy about 400 kWh/kWp, system annual generation 1300 kWh/kWp: EPT≈400/1300≈0.31 years (about 4 months), far shorter than the 25-year lifespan, giving a high net energy return. Tip: even including the manufacturing energy of brackets/inverters, the EPT is usually <2 years.
map.EPT 和财务回收期哪个长？: Which is longer, EPT or the financial payback period?
map.通常财务回收期更长（受电价与初投影响），EPT 仅看能量，是环境可持续性的指标。: The financial payback period is usually longer (affected by the electricity price and initial investment); EPT looks only at energy and is an environmental sustainability indicator.
map.制造工艺能耗、系统寿命、当地辐照/风资源；高资源区 EPT 更短。: Manufacturing energy, system lifespan and local solar/wind resources; high-resource areas have a shorter EPT.
map.⚠ 初投资与年节约不能为负值。: ⚠ Initial investment and annual savings cannot be negative.
map.年节约为 0：投资永远无法回收。: Annual savings are 0: the investment will never pay back.
map.节能投资回收期（本页代码口径）：回收期=初投资÷年节约额（年）；联动量：年回报率: Payback (page code definition): payback = initial investment ÷ annual savings (years); derived: annual return = annual savings ÷ initial investment × 100 (%), 10-year net benefit = annual savings × 10 − initial investment, 10-year cumulative savings = annual savings × 10 (CNY). Validation: either field empty → prompt and stop; both must be non-negative; when annual savings are 0, output "∞ (never pays back)" separately while keeping the other three metrics. Criterion: no fixed grading; shorter payback is better and it should normally be well below the equipment lifetime.
